Class Tile

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.gameModel.card.Tile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Tile extends Object implements Serializable
Representation of a Tile.
This Class works as the representation for a Tile, independently of its type of moves.

  • Constructor Details

    • Tile

      public Tile(Integer upArrows, Integer downArrows, Integer food)
      Constructor of a Tile.
      Pre: (upArrows > 0 || upArrows == null) && (downArrows > 0 || downArrows == null) && (food > 0 || food == null)
      Post: this.upArrows = upArrows && this.downArrows = downArrows && this.food = food
      Parameters:
      upArrows - Number of Cards which can be picked from the upper row.
      downArrows - Number of Cards which can be picked from the lower row.
      food - Food which the Player gains.

    • createRow

      public void createRow(StringBuilder ln1, StringBuilder ln2, StringBuilder ln3)
      Add Tile's info to the StringBuilders for the Terminal.
      This method works by adding the Tile's info to the StringBuilders, in order to display it properly on the Terminal.
      Pre: ln1 != null && ln2 != null && ln3 != null
      Parameters:
      ln1 - Line containing the number of Moves (Pick From Up) of the Tile.
      ln2 - Line containing the number of Moves (Pick From Down) of the Tile.
      ln3 - Line containing the Player currently positioned on the Tile.
